_schema.description: Bilateral flow matrix between six sectors. matrix[i][j] = flow volume from entity i to entity j. Used to drive a D3 chord diagram.

fields.names: string[] — ordered list of entity/node labels. Length N.
fields.matrix: number[][] — NxN symmetric or asymmetric flow matrix. matrix[i][i] must be 0. Non-zero matrix[i][j] draws a ribbon between node i and node j whose width at each end is proportional to the directional value.

_schema.replace: Swap 'names' with your entity labels and 'matrix' with your real flow values. The matrix does not need to be symmetric — different values for matrix[i][j] vs matrix[j][i] represent asymmetric flows. Zero values suppress that ribbon entirely. Keep matrix[i][i] = 0.
